SELECT * FROM ( SELECT u.USER_ID, NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL) AS USER_NAME, u.EMAIL, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN NULL ELSE NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, pi.CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH) END AS PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN NULL ELSE NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, pi.ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH) END AS PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, pi.CROP_SCALE) AS PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_X, pi.CROP_X) AS PROFILE_CROP_X, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_Y, pi.CROP_Y) AS PROFILE_CROP_Y, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN 'DEFAULT' WHEN UPPER(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE) = 'IMAGE' THEN 'IMAGE' WHEN NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, pi.CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH) IS NOT NULL OR NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, pi.ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH) IS NOT NULL THEN 'IMAGE' ELSE 'DEFAULT' END AS PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, f.FRIEND_ID, f.REQUESTER_ID, f.ADDRESSEE_ID, f.STATUS, f.REQUESTED_AT, f.RESPONDED_AT, f.UPDATED_AT, NVL(f.STATUS, 'NONE') AS RELATION_STATUS, CASE WHEN f.FRIEND_ID IS NULL THEN 'NONE' WHEN f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} THEN 'SENT' ELSE 'RECEIVED' END AS DIRECTION FROM USERS u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID, ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH, CROP_SCALE, CROP_X, CROP_Y FROM ( SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.USER_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.IS_CURRENT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.CREATED_AT DESC, p.PROFILE_IMAGE_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM USER_PROFILE_IMAGES p ) WHERE RN = 1 ) pi ON pi.USER_ID = u.USER_ID LEFT JOIN USER_FRIENDS f ON f.FRIEND_ID = ( SELECT MAX(ff.FRIEND_ID) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY NVL(ff.UPDATED_AT, ff.REQUESTED_AT), ff.FRIEND_ID ) FROM USER_FRIENDS ff WHERE ((ff.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND ff.ADDRESSEE_ID = u.USER_ID) OR (ff.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND ff.REQUESTER_ID = u.USER_ID)) AND ff.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'BLOCKED') ) WHERE u.USER_ID != #{userId} AND NVL(u.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE'
AND ( UPPER(NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(u.EMAIL) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL), u.EMAIL ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 30

SELECT f.FRIEND_ID, f.REQUESTER_ID, f.ADDRESSEE_ID, f.STATUS, f.REQUESTED_AT, f.RESPONDED_AT, f.UPDATED_AT, u.USER_ID, NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL) AS USER_NAME, u.EMAIL, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN NULL ELSE NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, pi.CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH) END AS PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN NULL ELSE NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, pi.ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH) END AS PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, pi.CROP_SCALE) AS PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_X, pi.CROP_X) AS PROFILE_CROP_X, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_Y, pi.CROP_Y) AS PROFILE_CROP_Y, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN 'DEFAULT' WHEN UPPER(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE) = 'IMAGE' THEN 'IMAGE' WHEN NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, pi.CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH) IS NOT NULL OR NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, pi.ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH) IS NOT NULL THEN 'IMAGE' ELSE 'DEFAULT' END AS PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, f.STATUS AS RELATION_STATUS, CASE WHEN f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} THEN 'SENT' ELSE 'RECEIVED' END AS DIRECTION, (SELECT MAX(p2.CREATED_AT) FROM USER_PROFILE_IMAGES p2 WHERE p2.USER_ID = u.USER_ID) AS LATEST_PROFILE_AT, (SELECT MAX(NVL(pp.UPDATED_AT, pp.CREATED_AT)) FROM PHOTO_POSTS pp WHERE pp.CREATED_BY = u.USER_ID AND NVL(pp.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND UPPER(NVL(pp.SCOPE_TYPE, 'PERSONAL')) = 'PERSONAL' AND UPPER(NVL(pp.VISIBILITY_TYPE, 'PRIVATE')) = 'FRIENDS') AS LATEST_PHOTO_AT, (SELECT MAX(pp.POST_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY NVL(pp.UPDATED_AT, pp.CREATED_AT), pp.POST_ID) FROM PHOTO_POSTS pp WHERE pp.CREATED_BY = u.USER_ID AND NVL(pp.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND UPPER(NVL(pp.SCOPE_TYPE, 'PERSONAL')) = 'PERSONAL' AND UPPER(NVL(pp.VISIBILITY_TYPE, 'PRIVATE')) = 'FRIENDS') AS LATEST_PHOTO_POST_ID, (SELECT MAX(NVL(n.UPD_DT, n.REG_DT)) FROM NOTES n WHERE n.USER_ID = u.USER_ID AND UPPER(NVL(n.SCOPE_TYPE, 'PRIVATE')) = 'PRIVATE' AND NVL(n.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(n.MOYO_PUBLIC_YN, 'N') = 'Y') AS LATEST_NOTE_AT, (SELECT MAX(n.NOTE_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY NVL(n.UPD_DT, n.REG_DT), n.NOTE_ID) FROM NOTES n WHERE n.USER_ID = u.USER_ID AND UPPER(NVL(n.SCOPE_TYPE, 'PRIVATE')) = 'PRIVATE' AND NVL(n.DELETED_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(n.MOYO_PUBLIC_YN, 'N') = 'Y') AS LATEST_NOTE_ID FROM USER_FRIENDS f JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = CASE WHEN f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} THEN f.ADDRESSEE_ID ELSE f.REQUESTER_ID END LEFT JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID, ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH, CROP_SCALE, CROP_X, CROP_Y FROM ( SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.USER_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.IS_CURRENT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.CREATED_AT DESC, p.PROFILE_IMAGE_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM USER_PROFILE_IMAGES p ) WHERE RN = 1 ) pi ON pi.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE f.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND (f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} OR f.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId}) AND NVL(u.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' AND f.FRIEND_ID = ( SELECT MAX(ff.FRIEND_ID) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY NVL(ff.UPDATED_AT, ff.REQUESTED_AT), ff.FRIEND_ID ) FROM USER_FRIENDS ff WHERE ff.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND ((ff.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND ff.ADDRESSEE_ID = u.USER_ID) OR (ff.REQUESTER_ID = u.USER_ID AND ff.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId})) )
AND ( UPPER(NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL)) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(u.EMAIL) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' )
ORDER BY NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL), u.EMAIL

WITH MY_FRIENDS AS ( SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} THEN f.ADDRESSEE_ID ELSE f.REQUESTER_ID END AS FRIEND_USER_ID FROM USER_FRIENDS f WHERE f.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND (f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} OR f.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId}) ), CANDIDATE_MUTUAL AS ( SELECT CANDIDATE_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT MUTUAL_USER_ID) AS MUTUAL_FRIEND_COUNT FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN cf.REQUESTER_ID = mf.FRIEND_USER_ID THEN cf.ADDRESSEE_ID ELSE cf.REQUESTER_ID END AS CANDIDATE_ID, mf.FRIEND_USER_ID AS MUTUAL_USER_ID FROM MY_FRIENDS mf JOIN USER_FRIENDS cf ON cf.STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND (cf.REQUESTER_ID = mf.FRIEND_USER_ID OR cf.ADDRESSEE_ID = mf.FRIEND_USER_ID) ) WHERE CANDIDATE_ID != #{userId} GROUP BY CANDIDATE_ID ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT u.USER_ID, NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL) AS USER_NAME, u.EMAIL, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN NULL ELSE NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, pi.CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH) END AS PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN NULL ELSE NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, pi.ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH) END AS PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, pi.CROP_SCALE) AS PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_X, pi.CROP_X) AS PROFILE_CROP_X, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_Y, pi.CROP_Y) AS PROFILE_CROP_Y, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN 'DEFAULT' WHEN UPPER(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE) = 'IMAGE' THEN 'IMAGE' WHEN NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, pi.CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH) IS NOT NULL OR NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, pi.ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH) IS NOT NULL THEN 'IMAGE' ELSE 'DEFAULT' END AS PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, cm.MUTUAL_FRIEND_COUNT, 'NONE' AS RELATION_STATUS, 'NONE' AS DIRECTION FROM CANDIDATE_MUTUAL cm JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = cm.CANDIDATE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID, ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH, CROP_SCALE, CROP_X, CROP_Y FROM ( SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.USER_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.IS_CURRENT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.CREATED_AT DESC, p.PROFILE_IMAGE_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM USER_PROFILE_IMAGES p ) WHERE RN = 1 ) pi ON pi.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE NVL(u.STATUS, 'ACTIVE') = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USER_FRIENDS rf WHERE ((rf.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND rf.ADDRESSEE_ID = u.USER_ID) OR (rf.REQUESTER_ID = u.USER_ID AND rf.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId})) AND rf.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'BLOCKED') ) ORDER BY cm.MUTUAL_FRIEND_COUNT DESC, NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL), u.USER_ID ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 8

SELECT f.FRIEND_ID, f.REQUESTER_ID, f.ADDRESSEE_ID, f.STATUS, f.REQUESTED_AT, f.RESPONDED_AT, f.UPDATED_AT, u.USER_ID, NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL) AS USER_NAME, u.EMAIL, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN NULL ELSE NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, pi.CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH) END AS PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN NULL ELSE NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, pi.ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH) END AS PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, pi.CROP_SCALE) AS PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_X, pi.CROP_X) AS PROFILE_CROP_X, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_Y, pi.CROP_Y) AS PROFILE_CROP_Y, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN 'DEFAULT' WHEN UPPER(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE) = 'IMAGE' THEN 'IMAGE' WHEN NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, pi.CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH) IS NOT NULL OR NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, pi.ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH) IS NOT NULL THEN 'IMAGE' ELSE 'DEFAULT' END AS PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, f.STATUS AS RELATION_STATUS, 'RECEIVED' AS DIRECTION FROM USER_FRIENDS f JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = f.REQUESTER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID, ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH, CROP_SCALE, CROP_X, CROP_Y FROM ( SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.USER_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.IS_CURRENT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.CREATED_AT DESC, p.PROFILE_IMAGE_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM USER_PROFILE_IMAGES p ) WHERE RN = 1 ) pi ON pi.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE f.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND f.STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY f.REQUESTED_AT DESC, f.FRIEND_ID DESC

SELECT f.FRIEND_ID, f.REQUESTER_ID, f.ADDRESSEE_ID, f.STATUS, f.REQUESTED_AT, f.RESPONDED_AT, f.UPDATED_AT, u.USER_ID, NVL(u.USER_NAME, u.EMAIL) AS USER_NAME, u.EMAIL, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN NULL ELSE NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, pi.CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH) END AS PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN NULL ELSE NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, pi.ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH) END AS PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, pi.CROP_SCALE) AS PROFILE_CROP_SCALE, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_X, pi.CROP_X) AS PROFILE_CROP_X, NVL(u.PROFILE_CROP_Y, pi.CROP_Y) AS PROFILE_CROP_Y, CASE WHEN UPPER(NVL(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, 'DEFAULT')) = 'DEFAULT' THEN 'DEFAULT' WHEN UPPER(u.PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE) = 'IMAGE' THEN 'IMAGE' WHEN NVL(u.PROFILE_IMAGE_PATH, pi.CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH) IS NOT NULL OR NVL(u.PROFILE_ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, pi.ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH) IS NOT NULL THEN 'IMAGE' ELSE 'DEFAULT' END AS PROFILE_AVATAR_TYPE, f.STATUS AS RELATION_STATUS, 'SENT' AS DIRECTION FROM USER_FRIENDS f JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = f.ADDRESSEE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID, ORIGINAL_IMAGE_PATH, CROPPED_IMAGE_PATH, CROP_SCALE, CROP_X, CROP_Y FROM ( SELECT p.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.USER_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.IS_CURRENT = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.CREATED_AT DESC, p.PROFILE_IMAGE_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM USER_PROFILE_IMAGES p ) WHERE RN = 1 ) pi ON pi.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND f.STATUS = 'PENDING' ORDER BY f.REQUESTED_AT DESC, f.FRIEND_ID DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_FRIENDS WHERE ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT f.FRIEND_ID, f.REQUESTER_ID, f.ADDRESSEE_ID, f.STATUS, f.REQUESTED_AT, f.RESPONDED_AT, f.UPDATED_AT, CASE WHEN f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} THEN 'SENT' ELSE 'RECEIVED' END AS DIRECTION FROM USER_FRIENDS f WHERE ((f.REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} AND f.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{targetUserId}) OR (f.REQUESTER_ID = #{targetUserId} AND f.ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId})) AND f.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'BLOCKED') ORDER BY f.UPDATED_AT DESC, f.FRIEND_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_FRIENDS SET STATUS = 'ACCEPTED', RESPONDED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE FRIEND_ID = #{friendId} AND ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE USER_FRIENDS SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', RESPONDED_AT = SYSDATE, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE FRIEND_ID = #{friendId} AND ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM USER_FRIENDS WHERE FRIEND_ID = #{friendId} AND STATUS = 'ACCEPTED' AND (REQUESTER_ID = #{userId} OR ADDRESSEE_ID = #{userId})
